The subject is positioned among lush green foliage and ferns in what appears to be a garden or park setting. The texture resembles painted fiberglass or rubber with simulated skin folds and scales. Only the head, part of the frill, and the very front of the shoulders are visible; the body, limbs, and tail are completely out of frame.
